title: Fundamentals of Applied Chemistry
topicTitle: Fundamentals of Applied Chemistry: chemical industry and its importance
notes: **Chemical industry:** converts raw materials into useful chemical products. One of the largest and most important industries globally.
**Importance:** provides fertilizers for agriculture, medicines for health, polymers for materials, fuels for energy, and pigments for decoration.
**Stages in producing a new product:** laboratory research â†’ pilot plant â†’ full-scale production â†’ quality control â†’ marketing.
**Economics:** cost of raw materials, energy consumption, labour, equipment, and waste disposal all affect the economic viability of a process.
**Environmental impact:** chemical plants produce waste gases ($SO_2$, $NO_x$), liquid effluents, and solid waste. Treatment and disposal costs must be included in process design.
